note: Freedom and democracy indicators. WHAT IS MEASURED: these indices score political rights and civil liberties (electoral integrity, freedom of expression/assembly, rule of law, constraints on executive, judicial independence) as coded by analysts — NOT policy preferences. Longer-term context: the US mid-20th century scored poorly on some dimensions (McCarthyism, segregation, disenfranchisement); the modern decline is measured from ~2015-16 bases that were already high. 2025 values (FH 81, V-Dem 0.57, EIU 7.65) verified and are record lows for each series.

freedom_house_score.note: US ~94 in 2010s; dropped to 83 (2021-2025 reports); 81 in 2026 report (covering 2025) — sharpest decline of any 'Free' country in the 2026 edition. Status remains 'Free'. 2026 values verified; historical ~approximate.

vdem_liberal_democracy_index.note: US 0.75 (2024) → 0.57 (2025): -24% in one year, lowest since 1965, ranked 51st (V-Dem v16, Democracy Report 2026). Recent values verified; older approximate.

eiu_democracy_index.note: US 7.65 (2025), ranked 34th, 'flawed democracy' — lowest since index began (2006). 2025 verified; older approximate.

polity2_score.note: US scored 10 (full democracy) continuously in the modern era (Polity5 ends 2018). Less sensitive than V-Dem/EIU to recent erosion.

trust_in_federal_government_pct.unit: % trusting government 'to do what is right' most of the time (PEW/Gallup)
trust_in_federal_government_pct.note: 1964 peak ~77%; modern era ~16-24% (2015-2024). Approximate benchmark values.

partisan_polarization_gap.unit: pp gap between R and D on Pew's 10-item values battery

congressional_approval_pct.note: Chronic ~15-30% since 2010; record low ~9-10% (2013 shutdown era). Approximate.

political_violence_qualitative.note: January 6, 2021 Capitol attack; assassination attempts (Trump 2024; Reagan 1981); threats against officials at record highs; violence against school boards/election workers post-2020. Post-WWII US has low organized political violence vs most democracies, but the 2020-2024 period shows elevated anti-institutional violence and threats relative to the 2000-2015 baseline.
